text:
jordan: Heads-up — customer reported rows missing from audit CSV export when using a custom RBAC role. Console v2, export -> CSV. Anyone seen this?

li: Yes, hit this yesterday. Export silently drops events when it can't decrypt the event payload (KMS decrypt failure) while streaming the CSV. File returns 200 but rows gone.

archibald: Can you post repro steps and a sample log line?

li: Repro steps: 1) create role with audit:read but no kms:decrypt 2) request /api/console/audit/export?format=csv 3) stream returns shorter file. Server log: `WARN export: row skipped decrypt error event_id=ev_01F... reason=kms.DecryptFailed`

sarah: If we drop rows that's a customer data integrity issue. We should either fail the export and surface an error or include a placeholder row with an error column. CC @miguel for export UX ideas.

miguel: Proposed schema change: add `export_validation_status` (OK|SKIPPED|ERROR) and optional `decryption_error` text. For CSV we can add a `__ERROR__` column with short codes. Also include export-level manifest with counts.

archibald: Schema v2 breaks older clients. Migration plan: if request includes `schema=v2` use new layout, otherwise fallback to legacy CSV (but still record skipped_count in server-side metadata). Also emit an audit event `audit.export.result` with success/skipped_count.

sec-bot: [auto] Potential issue flagged: integrity/confidentiality concern (P2). If rows dropped, customers may not be able to prove events existed. Recommend triage.

jordan: There's also pagination duplication when filters are applied (e.g., actor=service-x + time range). CSV sometimes contains duplicates across page boundaries — probably streaming cursor uses offset+timestamp ordering.

li: I can reproduce the dupes locally. Likely fix: stream by stable cursor (last_event_id) rather than offset. Will open PR for streaming cursor change.

sarah: For customer UX: show a preview count before export, and a runtime warning if some events will be skipped due to permissions/KMS. Also deliver export as a zip that contains `manifest.json` with `requested_count`, `exported_count`, `skipped_count`, and `errors` array.

miguel: Important KMS note: the export process must not try to decrypt with the service account key if the customer's policy forbids it. We should request a temporary decryption token scoped to the customer's key or fail fast. Log each decryption failure as `audit.export.decrypt_failed` with actor and key_id.

archibald: Triage questions: 1) Does skipping rows leak presence/absence of actions? 2) Does CSV filename or size reveal count? If so, impact increases. @sec-bot run sensitive-fields scan on example exports.

sec-bot: Scan queued; ETA ~30m.

jordan: Action items: li -> repro gist + collect logs; miguel -> draft schema RFC + migration plan; sarah -> UX mock + warning copy; archibald -> open triage ticket and coordinate legal if needed. I'll draft customer comms once we know scope. Timelines?

li: I’ll have repro and log excerpt by EOD tomorrow.

miguel: Schema RFC draft by Friday.

archibald: Triage ticket created: SEC-9876 (https://redwood.example/SEC-9876).

sarah: UX mock uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd — added notes about zip+manifest and preview count.

jordan: Thanks all — keeping this thread pinned. :pin:
